instruction.text: If £1 is equivalent to 100 Japanese Yen (¥), how many Yen would £2,350 be?
A football stadium holds 5,600 people. If each person buys a programme for £10, how much will be made in total?

atoms.a: If the price of the programme was increased by a factor of 10 how much money would be made?

instruction.text: A school decided to buy pencils for its 534 students. Each student will receive 10 pencils. How many pencils does the school need to buy in total?

atoms.a: If the school decides to buy 10 times more pencils for each student, how many pencils will they need?

instruction.text: The population of a city is 3,450,000 people, and the city covers an area of 1,000 square kilometres. What is the population density per square kilometre?

atoms.a: What would the population density be like, if the city only covered 100 square kilometres instead?

instruction.text: A farm produces 9,200 kilograms of apples each year. If the apples are packed into crates that each hold 100 kilograms, how many crates will the farm fill?

atoms.a: How many kilograms of apples would the farm need to produce to fill 232 crates?
